notes.title: Celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival
notes.notes: Celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival, one of the four traditional Chinese festivals. Come and eat some Zongzi to protect the goddess!

notes.title: Lucky Cat
notes.notes: Do you want more gold coins? Then bring the Lucky Cat!

notes.title: New character Superstar
notes.notes: New character superstar launched, paying tribute to popular culture

notes.title: Special effects modification
notes.notes: Adjusted values and changed special effects for certain skills

notes.title: Value adjustment
notes.notes: Adjust the difficulty of the opening game according to the player's feedback

notes.title: One more new charactor is now avaliable. Controller is also avaliable.
notes.notes:
One more charactor is avaliable, which makes this game more like tower defense, come and try this new weapon and dont forget the super and hyper weapon too.

Controller is also avaliable now, perfertly macth the control on Steam Deck, if you have the device, start the game and have a different experience playing.

notes.title: Combination guide is ready now!
notes.notes: Now you can find the combination list of all super weapon and hyper weapon in game, dont worry about forgetting the formular. HAVE FUN!

notes.title: 地图三--地下城已经发布，现在你可以和恶魔之王面对面战斗了
notes.notes:
地图三--地下城已经发布，现在你可以和恶魔之王面对面战斗了

新添加了时间扭曲模式。时间流动变快，可以获得更快的移速！

添加3个新的角色，同时包括三个新的武器和六项新的合成规则，尝试升级它们来获得更强大的武器！

因为收到了许多中国玩家的反馈，为了让他们玩的更容易些，我们添加了简体中文支持！

notes.title: Map 3 -- dungeon is ready, now you can fight the demon king face to face.
notes.notes:
Map 3 -- dungeon is ready, now you can fight the demon king face to face.

Time-twister is also ready now. It can faster the time flow and you will have to move faster too!

and 3 new characters are able to be summoned, which means that 3 new weapons and 6 more combinations are there to be found too. Try to upgrade them to super and hper weapons! 

Becasue of the many feedback from chinese players, and in order to let them play the game easier. Simplified Chinese is also avalible now!
